name: An Bang Beach
kicker: The beach stay on the Hoi An coast
summary: The Hoi An beach: sand and sea in front of a strip of villas and homestays, with basket boats pulled up on the shore. Swim or walk the sand in the morning while the old town has the afternoon, or give it half a day when the swim is the point. Choose it over Cửa Đại, where erosion is serious.
getThere: A ride or a bicycle from the old town
heroCaption: Sand, water, and the thatched front, with basket boats on the beach

notice.title: This is not a walk to the lantern streets
notice.body: An Bang is a ride from the old town. Sleep here and the evening in the old town means a ride back; sleep in the old town and the sand is not at the end of the lane.

body: The visit is the sand and the water, with the low thatched front behind the loungers. Villa and homestay lodging lines the beach, and it is the stay many foreign visitors choose. Give the beach a morning when the old town has the afternoon, or half a day when the swim is the point.

Erosion is serious at Cửa Đại, so swim here instead, and know that An Bang and Tân Thành are under threat too. An Bang, once in Cẩm An and now in Hoi An Tây, has been a recognised local tourism site since 2018.
Come in the morning, in the drier months from January to September. Ask the price of a chair before you sit down.

figures.caption: People in the water off the sand
figures.alt: Swimmers in the sea at An Bang, with the sand in the foreground and islands on the horizon

gettingThere: An Bang is on the coast in Hoi An Tây. Go by bicycle or a ride from the old town.
